zh_abstract: 用于配体发现的批主动学习需要反复决定是利用高预测亲和力、降低模型不确定性，还是拓宽化学覆盖范围。我们测试语言模型能否做出这种策略层面的决策，同时候选排序和标签揭示仍由确定性高斯过程环境控制。在四个蛋白质靶标、十个配对种子和 360 个化合物的测定预算下，GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体在所有 40 个匹配实验活动中均优于随机采样。其最终 top-2% 召回率在 D2R 上为 0.412，在 Mpro 上为 0.374，在 TYK2 上为 0.448，在 USP7 上为 0.683。它在 Mpro 和 USP7 上与最强固定策略统计打平，但在 D2R 和 TYK2 上表现不及靶标特异性领先策略。该智能体从面向探索的早期批次转向利用，并产生了 686 条可检验的阈值断言，原子成功率为 86.3%，尽管 19.8% 的预测无法进行数值评分。在 200 个预设定信息消融实验活动中，移除不确定性、多样性或记忆仅导致小的终点变化，而打乱解释性证据在 40 个配对实验活动中的 39 个中复现了完整分配路径。确定性 80% 可用性约束降低了每个靶标上的召回率，但保留了胜负的靶标依赖模式。这些结果支持语言模型策略控制是一种可行且可审计的层。

title: Representing biological concepts as directions in foundation model embeddings
zh_title: 用基础模型嵌入方向表示生物学概念
summary: 用概念激活向量在蛋白与单细胞基础模型嵌入中定位可解释、可复用的生物学属性方向。
key_points: CAV可恢复GO与EC注释、定位Pfam结构域
捕捉DNA结合与蛋白互作界面特异性
在单细胞嵌入中分离癌症相关表达转变
abstract: Biological foundation models encode rich information about protein structure, function, and cellular state in high-dimensional embeddings, but accessing specific biological properties typically relies on additional, task-specific prediction models. Here, we show that diverse biological properties can be mapped to interpretable, reusable directions in embedding space. In the Concept Activation Vector (CAV) approach, examples representing a concept are distinguished from a background set using a linear model, and the resulting weight vector defines the CAV for that concept. In protein embeddings, CAVs recover Gene Ontology and Enzyme Commission annotations, localize Pfam domains, reveal novel structural relationships, and capture DNA-binding and protein-interaction interface specificity. In single-cell embeddings, CAVs isolate cancer-associated expression transitions, and gene variation along these axes substantially agrees with conventional differential-expression analysis despite being a distinct computational approach. Together, these results establish concept directions as a common representation, enabling diverse biological features to be compared, localized, and manipulated.
reason: 可解释性新方法，覆盖多类生物学属性，但为预印本且无外部基准
zh_abstract: 生物基础模型在高维嵌入中编码关于蛋白质结构、功能和细胞状态的丰富信息，但访问特定生物学性质通常依赖额外的、任务特异性的预测模型。在此，我们表明多种生物学性质可以映射到嵌入空间中可解释、可复用的方向。在概念激活向量（Concept Activation Vector, CAV）方法中，使用线性模型将表示某一概念的样本与背景集区分开，所得权重向量定义该概念的 CAV。在蛋白质嵌入中，CAV 可恢复基因本体（Gene Ontology）和酶委员会（Enzyme Commission）注释、定位 Pfam 结构域、揭示新的结构关系，并捕获 DNA 结合和蛋白质相互作用界面特异性。在单细胞嵌入中，CAV 可分离癌症相关表达转变，并且沿这些轴的基因变异与传统差异表达分析高度一致，尽管它是一种不同的计算方法。总之，这些结果确立概念方向作为一种共同表示，使多种生物学特征能够被比较、定位和操控。

title: ClinStigma: A Clinician-Guided Framework for Developing Synthetic Benchmarks of Contextual Stigmatizing Language in Clinical Documentation
zh_title: ClinStigma：临床文书污名化语言合成基准框架
summary: 预印本提出临床医生指导的合成基准构建与标注框架ClinStigma，首个实现面向物质使用障碍临床文书的语境化污名语言评测。
key_points: 用前沿语言模型生成候选临床句子
依临床医生评分标准迭代评审
首个实现面向物质使用障碍文书
abstract: Objective Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, summarize, and evaluate clinical documentation, yet standardized methods for evaluating nuanced, context-dependent clinical language remain limited. Existing approaches rely primarily on annotated clinical corpora or keyword-based methods, restricting reproducibility, public dissemination, and systematic comparison across models. We present ClinStigma, a clinician-guided framework for constructing, annotating, and evaluating synthetic benchmarks of contextual stigmatizing language, demonstrated through ClinStigma-SUD, its inaugural implementation for substance use disorder documentation. Materials and Methods Candidate clinical sentences were generated using a frontier language model and iteratively reviewed according to a clinician-developed annotation rubric refined through expert review in stigmatizing language. The resulting benchmark intentionally incorporates explicit stigmatizing, neutral, and contextually ambiguous ("gray-zone") documentation requiring clinical reasoning rather than keyword recognition. Three locally deployed open-weight LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot inference, followed by external evaluation using independently annotated clinical documentation from MIMIC-IV. Results ClinStigma-SUD consists of 500 clinician-adjudicated synthetic clinical documentation sentences. Inter-rater agreement was 98.8% across the full benchmark (Cohen's {kappa} = 0.976) and 94.0% within the intentionally ambiguous subset ({kappa} = 0.880). Under zero-shot prompting, binary accuracy ranged from 84.8% to 91.8% across evaluated models, while F1 for the ambiguous (gray) class ranged from 0.038 to 0.423. Zero-shot external evaluation on 3,716 annotated examples from the independently annotated Harrigian MIMIC-IV corpus yielded 84.4% accuracy (84.4% balanced accuracy; macro F1 0.824), against a 69.9% majority-class baseline. Stigmatizing-class F1 was 0.879 in the substance-related subgroup and 0.883 in the full external corpus. Discussion and Conclusion ClinStigma establishes a reproducible clinician-guided framework for developing synthetic evaluation benchmarks for contextual clinical language. By combining structured clinical expertise, explicit annotation guidance, synthetic benchmark generation, and external evaluation, the framework enables open, privacy-preserving evaluation of language models while providing a scalable foundation for benchmark development across additional cli

zh_abstract: 【目的】大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于生成、总结和评估临床文档，然而用于评估细微、依赖上下文的临床语言的标准化方法仍然有限。现有方法主要依赖带注释的临床语料库或基于关键词的方法，限制了可重复性、公开传播以及跨模型的系统比较。我们提出 ClinStigma，一个由临床医生引导的框架，用于构建、注释和评估情境化污名化语言的合成基准，并通过 ClinStigma-SUD 展示，这是其针对物质使用障碍文档的首个实现。【材料与方法】候选临床句子使用前沿语言模型生成，并根据临床医生开发的注释准则迭代审查，该准则通过污名化语言专家审查进一步完善。所得基准有意纳入明确的污名化、中性以及情境模糊（“灰色地带”）文档，这些文档需要临床推理而非关键词识别。使用零样本推理评估了三个本地部署的开放权重 LLM，随后使用来自 MIMIC-IV 的独立注释临床文档进行外部评估。【结果】ClinStigma-SUD 由 500 条经临床医生裁定的合成临床文档句子组成。评分者间一致性在整个基准中为 98.8%（Cohen's {kappa} = 0.976），在有意模糊子集中为 94.0%（{kappa} = 0.880）。在零样本提示下，所评估模型的二分类准确率范围为 84.8% 至 91.8%，而模糊（灰色）类别的 F1 范围为 0.038 至 0.423。对来自独立注释的 Harrigian MIMIC-IV 语料库的 3,716 个注释示例进行零样本外部评估，得到 84.4% 准确率（84.4% 平衡准确率；宏 F1 0.824），相对于 69.9% 的多数类基线。污名化类别的 F1 在物质相关亚组中为 0.879，在完整外部语料库中为 0.883。【讨论与结论】ClinStigma 建立了一个可重复、由临床医生引导的框架，用于开发情境化临床语言的合成评估基准。通过结合结构化临床专业知识、明确的注释指导、合成基准生成和外部评估，该框架能够对语言模型进行开放、保护隐私的评估，同时为跨其他 cli 的基准开发提供可扩展基础。

title: HERO: Hierarchical Evidential Reasoning Optimization for Radiology Report Generation via Reason-then-Summarize
zh_title: HERO：放射报告生成的分层证据推理优化
summary: arXiv预印本提出HERO，以分段、token与完成三级策略优化缓解GRPO统一信用分配问题，旨在减少放射报告生成的临床幻觉。
key_points: 针对GRPO整段统一信用分配缺陷
分段、token、完成三级优化粒度
奖励融合诊断准确率与推理一致性
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Radiology Report Generation (RRG), yet aligning them through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging due to heterogeneous medical supervision. Vanilla Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns uniform credit across the entire generation, leading to segment interference, token dilution, and rationale-diagnosis decoupling, which exacerbates clinical hallucinations. We propose HERO (Hierarchical rationalE Reasoning Optimization), a factorized policy optimization framework that aligns heterogeneous supervision with three optimization granularities. HERO separately optimizes reasoning, diagnosis, and rationale faithfulness through complementary segment-, token-, and completion-level optimization with a heterogeneous reward formulation covering diagnostic accuracy, reasoning quality, and think-answer consistency. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray show that HERO outperforms strong supervised and reinforcement learning baselines, achieving state-of-the-art clinical efficacy while producing more rationale-supported and think-answer-consistent reports, thereby substantially mitigating clinical hallucinations.

zh_abstract: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）已大幅推进放射学报告生成（RRG），然而由于医学监督的异质性，通过强化学习（RL）对其进行对齐仍然具有挑战性。原始组相对策略优化（GRPO）在整个生成过程中分配统一的信用，导致片段干扰、词元稀释以及理由-诊断解耦，从而加剧临床幻觉。我们提出 HERO（Hierarchical rationalE Reasoning Optimization，分层理由推理优化），一个因子化策略优化框架，通过三种优化粒度对齐异质性监督。HERO 通过互补的片段级、词元级和完成级优化，分别优化推理、诊断和理由忠实度，并采用涵盖诊断准确性、推理质量和思考-答案一致性的异质性奖励公式。在 MIMIC-CXR 和 IU-Xray 上的实验表明，HERO 优于强监督学习和强化学习基线，达到最先进的临床效能，同时产生更多有理由支持且思考-答案一致的报告，从而大幅减轻临床幻觉。

title: AI chatbots abandon sleep apnoea referral when simulated patients minimise symptoms
zh_title: 患者淡化症状时聊天机器人放弃睡眠呼吸暂停转诊
summary: 预印本研究用 700 组模拟对话测试五种免费聊天机器人，发现患者淡化症状时模型不再维持指南一致的转诊建议。
key_points: 五个模型×七个 OSA 情景×两种条件
共 700 组模拟对话，结构化量规评分
要求症状淡化下仍维持转诊建议
abstract: Background: Patients increasingly consult free artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots about their symptoms, but these models may favour agreement with the patient over accuracy. In obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA), where most cases in the general population remain undiagnosed and diagnosis depends on referral, this could validate symptom denial. We tested whether consumer chatbots maintain guideline-concordant referral when a simulated patient minimises symptoms. Methods: Seven guideline-concordant and standardised OSA vignettes (apnoea-hypopnoea-index, AHI 8-52 events/h; body mass index 28-42 kg/m2) were presented to five free chatbots (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Grok-4.3) under neutral and symptom-minimising conditions (10 simulated conversations per model-vignette-condition cell; N=700). Referral maintenance was scored by a structured rubric and every capitulation was human-confirmed. Results: All chatbots maintained referral recommendations in neutral conversations (350/350; 100%). When simulated patients minimised symptoms and resisted referral, maintenance fell to 64.3% (225/350), a reduction of 35.7 percentage points (95% CI 5.5-66.0; p=0.028). Rates ranged from 55.7% to 85.7% across chatbots, but evidence of between-chatbot differences was inconsistent across analyses. Rates differed across clinical vignettes (p=0.001). A variance analysis estimated greater variation between vignettes than between chatbots. In the three driving-risk vignettes, referral recommendations were abandoned in 46-68% of symptom-minimising conversations, pooling all five chatbots within each vignette. Conclusions: Consumer AI chatbots abandoned correct OSA referral recommendations in about one-third of symptom-minimising conversations, with higher observed abandonment in simulated cases involving driving risk. This may delay appropriate assessment and raises patient- and public-safety concerns.

zh_abstract: 【背景】患者越来越多就自身症状咨询免费人工智能（AI）聊天机器人，但这些模型可能优先迎合患者而非准确性。在阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）中，一般人群中的大多数病例仍未确诊，且诊断依赖转诊，这可能使否认症状得到认可。我们测试了当模拟患者淡化症状时，消费级聊天机器人是否仍能维持符合指南的转诊建议。【方法】将七个符合指南且标准化的 OSA 情景（呼吸暂停低通气指数，AHI 8-52 次/小时；体重指数 28-42 kg/m2）以中立和淡化症状两种条件呈现给五个免费聊天机器人（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 Grok-4.3）（每个模型-情景-条件单元进行 10 次模拟对话；N=700）。转诊维持情况由结构化评分标准评分，且每次让步均经人工确认。【结果】所有聊天机器人在中立对话中均维持了转诊建议（350/350；100%）。当模拟患者淡化症状并抗拒转诊时，维持率降至 64.3%（225/350），下降了 35.7 个百分点（95% CI 5.5-66.0；p=0.028）。各聊天机器人的比率范围为 55.7% 至 85.7%，但各分析中聊天机器人之间存在差异的证据不一致。不同临床情景之间的比率存在差异（p=0.001）。方差分析估计，情景之间的变异大于聊天机器人之间的变异。在三个驾驶风险情景中，在每个情景内汇总所有五个聊天机器人后，淡化症状的对话中有 46-68% 放弃了转诊建议。【结论】消费级 AI 聊天机器人在约三分之一的淡化症状对话中放弃了正确的 OSA 转诊建议，在涉及驾驶风险的模拟病例中观察到的放弃率更高。这可能延迟适当评估，并引发患者和公共安全担忧。

title: The content of biomedical papers predicts future clinical trials: a proof-of-concept framework tested on CAR-T cell therapy
zh_title: 生物医学论文内容预测未来临床试验：CAR-T概念验证
summary: 预印本以CAR-T为概念验证场景，用论文固有指标训练机器学习模型，预测哪些论文会进入临床试验。
key_points: 以CAR-T细胞治疗为概念验证场景
65项论文固有指标，交叉验证AUC 0.908
回顾性设置下排名前20论文中80%来自相关实验室
abstract: This paper shows that it is possible to predict which newly published biomedical research papers will be connected to subsequent clinical trials. We use CAR-T cell therapy as a proof-of-concept setting because its development can be followed from published research through clinical testing, regulatory approval, and commercialization. We reconstructed connections between research papers and clinical trials and trained machine-learning models to predict which papers were associated with research that progressed to clinical testing. Using 65 paper-inherent indicators, including scientific topic, language, biomedical orientation, and team structure, the models achieved a cross-validated AUC of 0.908. The resulting rankings were also practically informative. In a retrospective analysis using no information generated after 2016, 80% of the top 20 papers came from laboratories associated with one of 13 predefined major CAR-T clinical or commercial outcomes. As an additional finding, first-year citations alone achieved an AUC of 0.797, while provenance indicators based on author, journal, and institutional reputation performed less strongly and added little to the paper-inherent model. Our results show that whether biomedical research papers will be connected to subsequent clinical trials can be predicted from newly published papers with high discrimination in CAR-T. Our findings could help research organizations and pharmaceutical companies identify papers, laboratories, and therapeutic programs that warrant closer evaluation before clinical outcomes are known.

zh_abstract: 本文表明，可以预测哪些新发表的生物医学研究论文将与后续临床试验相关联。我们使用 CAR-T 细胞疗法作为概念验证场景，因为其开发过程可以从已发表研究一直追踪到临床测试、监管批准和商业化。我们重建了研究论文与临床试验之间的联系，并训练机器学习模型来预测哪些论文与进展到临床测试的研究相关。使用 65 个论文固有指标，包括科学主题、语言、生物医学方向和团队结构，模型实现了交叉验证 AUC 为 0.908。由此产生的排名也具有实际信息价值。在一项不使用 2016 年之后生成的任何信息的回顾性分析中，排名前 20 的论文中有 80% 来自与 13 个预先定义的主要 CAR-T 临床或商业成果之一相关的实验室。作为一项额外发现，仅第一年引用量就达到了 AUC 为 0.797，而基于作者、期刊和机构声誉的来源指标表现较弱，并且对论文固有模型几乎没有增加价值。我们的结果表明，在 CAR-T 中，可以从新发表论文中以高区分度预测生物医学研究论文是否将与后续临床试验相关联。我们的发现可帮助研究组织和制药公司在临床结果已知之前识别值得更密切评估的论文、实验室和治疗项目。

title: Open Foundation Models in Healthcare: Challenges, Paradoxes, and Opportunities with GenAI Driven Personalized Prescription
zh_title: 医疗开放基础模型：挑战、悖论与个性化处方
summary: 综述开放LLM与AI基础模型在临床任务的进展，并在个性化处方任务上比较开源与专有模型。
key_points: 梳理开放LLM/AIFM临床任务的分类体系
在100个合成患者画像上评测处方任务
开源模型总体适用性准确率0.810–0.850，专有基线0.780
abstract: In response to the success of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in developing open, non-proprietary LLMs and AI foundation models (AIFMs) for transparent use in academic, scientific, and non-commercial applications. Open models have substantial potential to improve healthcare applications. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and a taxonomy of state-of-the-art open LLMs and AIFMs for clinical tasks. In addition, we empirically evaluate open-weight LLMs on a personalized-prescription task and compare them with a proprietary model with and without Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Across 100 synthetic patient profiles, the open-weight models matched or exceeded the proprietary baseline on overall suitability accuracy without retrieval augmentation (0.810--0.850 versus 0.780), although the confidence intervals overlap; with retrieval augmentation, every model improved, and the ranking closed to within 0.04. Gains from RAG were field-dependent rather than uniform. To highlight the clinical relevance of LLM-driven personalized prescriptions, we also conduct a subjective evaluation in which two raters, blinded to model and condition, scored responses independently of each other. Their ratings did not follow the accuracy gains: retrieval raised overall suitability accuracy for every model while lowering the two-rater means for two of the four on all five dimensions. Finally, we outline the ethical implications and potential risks associated with the misuse of advanced LLMs and AIFMs, highlighting the importance of responsible and transparent deployment in healthcare contexts. \textit{Data and code used in the paper will be released upon publication.

title: From examinations to consultations: a physician-reviewed Japanese benchmark for large language models in traditional Kampo medicine
zh_title: 日本汉方医学大模型医生评审基准KampoBench
summary: 预印本发布经汉方专科医师修订的74个咨询场景、310条评分标准，评测10个大模型。
key_points: 74个咨询场景、310条评分标准

abstract: Objectives: Patients and clinicians increasingly ask large language models (LLMs) about Kampo, Japan's traditional medicine. Yet evaluations of LLMs have measured accuracy on examination questions, which ask what a model knows; a consultation asks whether it can apply that knowledge to the patient at hand. No benchmark had measured that. Materials and Methods: KampoBench comprises 74 consultation scenarios and 310 conversation-specific rubric criteria, following the design of HealthBench. Scenarios, criteria and reference answers were drafted by an LLM and revised by board-certified Kampo physicians. Ten current models from three vendors were evaluated. Because LLM graders are known to favor their own family, each response was graded by a model from each vendor. Results: The best model reached 74.8-86.3% across graders, the physician-revised reference answers 87.9-92.4%. Rankings were stable across graders (Spearman's rho 0.952-0.976), and the family-favoring deviation was 0.4 to 0.6 percentage points, below the bootstrap standard deviation of one measurement; grader leniency varied by 14.3 points. Models were most reliable on criteria about advising that care be sought (83.6%) and least reliable on those requiring a known crude-drug risk to be tied to the case (17.5%), though 79.2% of those responses named the drug. Discussion: The shortfall lay in applying knowledge to the case rather than in holding it - a distinction examination-format evaluations cannot make. Conclusion: Evaluation in traditional medicine should measure the judgments a consultation requires, not recall alone. Quoted alongside the grader that produced it, a KampoBench score is a usable measure of those judgments.

zh_abstract: 【目的】患者和临床医生越来越多地向大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）询问汉方（Kampo），即日本传统医学。然而，对 LLM 的评估测量的是考试题上的准确率，这类题目问的是模型知道什么；而一次咨询问的是它能否将这些知识应用于眼前的患者。此前尚无基准测量这一点。【材料与方法】KampoBench 包含 74 个咨询场景和 310 条针对具体对话的评分细则标准，遵循 HealthBench 的设计。场景、标准和参考答案由 LLM 起草，并由获得委员会认证的汉方医师修订。评估了来自三家供应商的十种当前模型。由于已知 LLM 评分器会偏袒自身家族，每条回复均由来自每家供应商的一个模型评分。【结果】最佳模型在不同评分器下达到 74.8-86.3%，医师修订的参考答案达到 87.9-92.4%。排名在不同评分器间稳定（Spearman's rho 0.952-0.976），偏袒自身家族的偏差为 0.4 至 0.6 个百分点，低于单次测量的自助法标准差；评分器宽松度变化为 14.3 个百分点。模型在关于建议寻求医疗照护的标准上最可靠（83.6%），在要求将已知生药风险与该病例联系起来的标准上最不可靠（17.5%），不过这些回复中有 79.2% 提到了该药。【讨论】不足之处在于将知识应用于病例，而非拥有知识——这是考试形式的评估无法作出的区分。【结论】传统医学中的评估应衡量一次咨询所需的判断，而不仅仅是回忆。与产生该评分的评分器一同引用时，KampoBench 分数是衡量这些判断的一个可用指标。

title: Horizon Scans can be accelerated using novel information retrieval and artificial intelligence tools

abstract: Introduction: Horizon scanning in healthcare assesses early signals of innovation, crucial for timely adoption. Current horizon scanning faces challenges in efficient information retrieval and analysis, especially in grey literature, presenting a need for innovative tools. Methodology: This article introduces SCANAR and AIDOC, open-source Python-based tools designed to improve horizon scanning. SCANAR automates the retrieval and processing of news articles, using de-duplication and unsupervised relevancy ranking. AIDOC aids filtration by leveraging large language models and text embeddings for calculation of semantic similarity, to reorder data based on relevancy. Results: Twelve internal datasets from horizon scans and four external benchmarking datasets were used. SCANAR improved retrieval efficiency by automating processes previously dependent on manual labour. AIDOC displayed work-saving potential, achieving around 65% theoretic reduction in manual review efforts at 95% recall or 20% reduction when adding CMH, an existing open-source algorithm to make data-driven decisions on stopping screening early. Comparative analysis with benchmarking data showed AIDOC's performance was similar to existing systematic review automation tools, though performance varied depending on dataset characteristics. Conclusion: The validation indicates that SCANAR and AIDOC show potential to enhance horizon scanning efficiency by streamlining data retrieval and prioritisation. These tools may alleviate methodological limitations and allow broader, swifter horizon scans. Further studies are suggested to optimize these models and to design new workflows and validation processes that integrate large language models.

title: Graph Neural Network-Based Reinforcement Learning for Controlling Biological Networks - the GATTACA Framework
zh_title: GATTACA：图神经网络强化学习控制生物网络
summary: 研究用深度强化学习控制基因调控与信号通路等布尔网络模型，提出可扩展框架 GATTACA，服务细胞重编程等应用。
key_points: 以布尔网络建模基因调控与信号通路
提出可扩展控制框架 GATTACA

abstract: Cellular reprogramming, the artificial transformation of one cell type into another, has been attracting increasing research attention due to its therapeutic potential for complex diseases. However, identifying effective reprogramming strategies through classical wet-lab experiments is hindered by lengthy time commitments and high costs. In this study, we explore the use of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to control Boolean network models of complex biological systems, such as gene regulatory and signalling pathway networks. We formulate a novel control problem for Boolean network models under the asynchronous update mode, specifically in the context of cellular reprogramming. To solve it, we devise GATTACA, a scalable computational framework. To facilitate scalability of our framework, we consider previously introduced concept of a pseudo-attractor and improve the procedure for effective identification of pseudo-attractor states. We then incorporate graph neural networks with graph convolution operations into the artificial neural network approximator of the DRL agent's action-value function. This allows us to leverage the available knowledge on the structure of a biological system and to indirectly, yet effectively, encode the system's modelled dynamics into a latent representation. Experiments on several large-scale, real-world biological networks from the literature demonstrate the scalability and effectiveness of our approach.

zh_abstract: 细胞重编程，即人工将一种细胞类型转化为另一种细胞类型，因其对复杂疾病的治疗潜力而受到越来越多的研究关注。然而，通过经典湿实验识别有效的重编程策略受到耗时长和成本高的阻碍。在本研究中，我们探索使用深度强化学习（DRL）来控制复杂生物系统的布尔网络模型，例如基因调控和信号通路网络。我们针对异步更新模式下的布尔网络模型，特别是在细胞重编程背景下，构建了一个新的控制问题。为解决该问题，我们设计了GATTACA，一个可扩展的计算框架。为促进我们框架的可扩展性，我们考虑先前引入的伪吸引子（pseudo-attractor）概念，并改进有效识别伪吸引子状态的过程。随后，我们将带有图卷积运算的图神经网络纳入DRL智能体动作价值函数的人工神经网络近似器中。这使我们能够利用关于生物系统结构的已有知识，并间接而有效地将系统的建模动态编码为潜在表示。对文献中若干大规模、真实世界生物网络的实验证明了我们方法的可扩展性和有效性。

title: Precision Evidence Bench: Assessing PICO alignment and faithful reporting in clinical AI
zh_title: Precision Evidence Bench：临床AI的PICO对齐与忠实报告评估
summary: 公开释放Precision Evidence Bench，含209个合成临床问题，用五维量表评估AI回答与PICO的对齐及来源忠实度。
key_points: 公开基准含209个合成临床问题

abstract: Clinicians routinely make decisions for patients whose comorbidities, prior therapies, laboratory abnormalities, or demographic characteristics are not reflected in the supporting evidence, even though these factors can influence treatment selection. Given this gap in the evidence base, we sought to evaluate how AI models respond to clinical questions in which patient characteristics or the treatment comparison and outcome of interest may affect the applicability of available evidence. We developed and publicly released Precision Evidence Bench, a benchmark of 209 synthetic clinical questions with specified population, intervention, comparator, and outcome (PICO) elements. Each answer is assessed using a five-item rubric that evaluates whether a single cited source matches the PICO and whether the answer faithfully reports its sources. The item verdicts determine one of five ratings, ranging from Precision match to Unsupported claim, without requiring a reference answer. We evaluated four frontier large language models (LLMs) using web search across all 209 questions, then repeated the evaluation with additional access to a corpus of precision evidence-based findings (pEBFs) designed to address these evidence gaps, using two corpus sizes. For every model, Precision match rates increased with the amount of precision evidence available, from 13 to 18% with web search alone to 17 to 28% with 100 million pEBFs and 41 to 56% with 500 million pEBFs. These findings suggest that access to matching evidence is an important determinant of LLM performance on precision medicine questions.

zh_abstract: 临床医生经常为那些合并症、既往治疗、实验室异常或人口学特征未反映在支持性证据中的患者做出决策，尽管这些因素可能影响治疗选择。鉴于证据基础中的这一缺口，我们试图评估 AI 模型如何回答以下临床问题：其中患者特征或所关注的干预比较和结局可能影响现有证据的适用性。我们开发并公开发布了 Precision Evidence Bench，这是一个包含 209 个合成临床问题的基准，这些问题明确指定了人群、干预、对照和结局（PICO）要素。每个答案使用五项评分量表进行评估，该量表评估单一引用来源是否与 PICO 匹配，以及答案是否忠实报告其来源。各项评分判定确定五种评级之一，范围从 Precision match 到 Unsupported claim，且不需要参考答案。我们使用网络搜索在所有 209 个问题上评估了四个前沿大语言模型（LLM），然后在额外访问一个旨在解决这些证据缺口的精准循证发现（pEBFs）语料库的情况下重复评估，使用两种语料库规模。对于每个模型，Precision match 率均随可用精准证据数量的增加而上升，从仅使用网络搜索时的 13% 至 18%，上升到使用 1 亿条 pEBFs 时的 17% 至 28%，以及使用 5 亿条 pEBFs 时的 41% 至 56%。这些发现表明，获取匹配证据是 LLM 在精准医学问题上表现的重要决定因素。

summary: 基于1522例患者电子病历，每21天动态估计未来30天首次≥2级irAE风险。
key_points: 1522例患者、18744个评估节点

abstract: ObjectiveTo develop and evaluate a dynamic model that repeatedly estimates the 30-day risk of a first grade [≥]2 immune-related adverse event (irAE) during immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy. Materials and MethodsAdults initiating ICI therapy during 2015-2022 comprised the development cohort; 2023 initiators formed a nonoverlapping internal temporal evaluation cohort. Every 21 days during the first treatment year, models used available EHR information to predict a first structured phenotype-defined grade [≥]2 irAE during the next 30 days. Evaluation included pooled and within-landmark discrimination, precision-recall performance, calibration, and patient-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals. Feature-state ablations and alternative update schedules examined the contribution of dynamic information. ResultsDevelopment included 1,522 patients and 18,744 evaluable landmarks; temporal evaluation included 526 patients and 6,263 landmarks, of which 184 were positive (2.94%). The multiscale XGBoost model achieved pooled AUROC 0.716 (95% CI, 0.676-0.755), AUPRC 0.067, within-landmark AUROC 0.672 (95% CI, 0.631-0.716), Brier score 0.0281, and log loss 0.1245. The time-aware baseline achieved AUROC 0.631 and within-landmark AUROC 0.536. Updated treatment exposure and laboratory trajectories accounted for most of the gain. A complete-state extension achieved AUROC 0.719 and AUPRC 0.073. The 21-day schedule had the highest discrimination among tested cadences. ConclusionLongitudinal EHR updating improved near-term irAE prediction beyond pretreatment characteristics and treatment time. Phenotype adjudication and independent evaluation of calibration, transportability, and clinical utility are needed before implementation.

zh_abstract:
【目的】开发并评估一个动态模型，该模型在免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗期间反复估计首次[≥]2级免疫相关不良事件（irAE）的30天风险。
【材料与方法】2015-2022年期间开始ICI治疗的成人组成开发队列；2023年开始治疗者组成非重叠的内部时间评估队列。在治疗第一年期间每21天，模型使用可获得的EHR信息预测未来30天内首次由结构化表型定义的[≥]2级irAE。评估包括合并和标志点内区分度、精确率-召回率性能、校准以及患者聚簇自助法置信区间。特征状态消融和替代更新计划检查了动态信息的贡献。
【结果】开发队列包含1,522例患者和18,744个可评估标志点；时间评估队列包含526例患者和6,263个标志点，其中184个为阳性（2.94%）。多尺度XGBoost模型达到合并AUROC 0.716（95% CI，0.676-0.755）、AUPRC 0.067、标志点内AUROC 0.672（95% CI，0.631-0.716）、Brier评分0.0281和对数损失0.1245。时间感知基线达到AUROC 0.631和标志点内AUROC 0.536。更新后的治疗暴露和实验室轨迹解释了大部分增益。完整状态扩展达到AUROC 0.719和AUPRC 0.073。在测试的节奏中，21天计划具有最高区分度。
【结论】纵向EHR更新改善了近期irAE预测，超越了治疗前特征和治疗时间。在实施前，需要进行表型判定以及校准、可迁移性和临床效用的独立评估。

abstract: High-fidelity surgical video generation is increasingly important for surgical education, simulation, and downstream AI training, as conventional simulation pipelines are limited by cost, realism, and scenario diversity. Adapting generic text-to-video diffusion models to surgical procedures remains difficult, however, due to complex anatomical structures, intricate tool-tissue interactions, the inherently hierarchical nature of surgical workflows, and the scarcity of curated training data outside a few well-studied procedures. We propose a surgical video generation framework that combines hierarchical procedural annotation with curriculum transfer learning. Surgical procedures are decomposed into three levels (phase, task, and action) and a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model is progressively adapted from coarse to fine-grained surgical context, supported by a dynamic sampling strategy that handles variable-resolution and variable-length surgical clips. We instantiate the framework on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach robotic thyroidectomy, a procedure for which no curated benchmark currently exists. Relative to the preceding task-level model, the final action-level model reduces FVD by 20.1% and FID by 15.7%, and a matched-budget ablation indicates that these gains arise from the curriculum design rather than from additional training. A user study with six clinicians rates visual realism highly while highlighting remaining gaps in anatomical accuracy and clinical reliability. The proposed framework offers a step toward AI-driven surgical simulation in procedures where curated data are scarce.

zh_abstract: 高保真手术视频生成对于手术教育、模拟和下游 AI 训练日益重要，因为传统模拟流程受到成本、真实感和场景多样性的限制。然而，将通用的文本到视频扩散模型适配到外科手术仍然困难，原因包括复杂的解剖结构、精细的工具-组织交互、手术工作流内在的层级性质，以及在少数研究充分的手术之外缺乏精选训练数据。我们提出一个手术视频生成框架，将层级化手术标注与课程迁移学习相结合。手术过程被分解为三个层级（阶段、任务和动作），预训练的文本到视频扩散模型从粗粒度到细粒度手术语境逐步适配，并辅以一种动态采样策略来处理可变分辨率和可变长度的手术视频片段。我们在双侧腋窝-乳房入路（Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach）机器人甲状腺切除术上实例化该框架，该手术目前尚无精选基准。相对于前一个任务级模型，最终的动作级模型将 FVD 降低 20.1%、FID 降低 15.7%，而匹配预算的消融表明这些增益来自课程设计而非额外训练。一项有六名临床医生参与的用户研究对视觉真实感评分很高，同时强调了在解剖准确性和临床可靠性方面仍存在的差距。所提出的框架为在精选数据稀缺的手术中实现 AI 驱动的手术模拟迈出了一步。

title: Considerations for implementing a machine learning model for suicide risk in the health systems that serve American Indian communities
zh_title: 服务美洲原住民社区的机器学习自杀风险模型实施考量
summary: 预印本以决策曲线分析评估自杀风险模型在服务美洲原住民医院的净获益与工作负荷。

abstract: ObjectiveWe explored the implementation considerations of machine learning (ML) suicide risk identification in a health system that serves primarily American Indian patients in the Southwestern United States. Previous work developed and reported the performance of suicide risk models, but traditional performance metrics do not directly reflect clinical workflows. Materials and MethodsUsing EHR data collected for Emergency Department (ED) visits between 10/01/2019 and 10/02/2021, we conducted Decision Curve Analysis (DCA) to identify the standardized net benefit (SNB) of all models previously evaluated and plotted the potential workload implications of the model with the greatest SNB. Finally, we evaluated suicide screening practices during the study period to inform implementation barriers. ResultsAmong 9,244 patients, 139 (1.5%) had a suicide attempt or death within 90 days of an included visit. The population-specific logistic regression model had the greatest SNB compared to other approaches. When operationalized, the 95th percentile cutoff did not substantially increase clinical workloads, while the 75th percentile cutoff substantially impacted workloads. The secondary analysis on suicide screening depicted variations in screening administration over time. DiscussionWhile DCA identified advantages of ML suicide risk identification over current standards, the complexities of suicide-related care limited its clinical interpretability. A stepped-care framework may mitigate potential workload burdens. Training initiatives and dynamic implementation strategies will support high-quality implementation of ML suicide risk identification. ConclusionOur analyses support the feasibility and utility of augmenting existing suicide screening practices with ML suicide risk identification, and demonstrate the importance of nuanced analyses to inform implementation considerations.

zh_abstract:
【目的】我们探讨了在一个主要服务于美国西南部美洲印第安人患者的卫生系统中，实施机器学习（ML）自杀风险识别的考虑因素。既往工作开发并报告了自杀风险模型的性能，但传统性能指标并不直接反映临床工作流程。
【材料与方法】使用2019年10月1日至2021年10月2日期间急诊科（ED）就诊收集的EHR数据，我们进行决策曲线分析（DCA），以确定先前评估的所有模型的标准化净获益（SNB），并绘制具有最大SNB的模型的潜在工作量影响。最后，我们评估研究期间的自杀筛查实践，以了解实施障碍。
【结果】在9,244例患者中，139例（1.5%）在纳入就诊后90天内发生自杀企图或死亡。与其他方法相比，人群特异性逻辑回归模型具有最大的SNB。在投入应用时，第95百分位截断值并未显著增加临床工作量，而第75百分位截断值则显著影响工作量。关于自杀筛查的二次分析描绘了筛查实施随时间的变化。
【讨论】虽然DCA确定了ML自杀风险识别相对于当前标准的优势，但自杀相关照护的复杂性限制了其临床可解释性。阶梯式照护框架可能减轻潜在的工作量负担。培训举措和动态实施策略将支持ML自杀风险识别的高质量实施。
【结论】我们的分析支持以ML自杀风险识别增强现有自杀筛查实践的可行性和效用，并证明细致分析对于为实施考虑提供信息的重要性。

title: Can Generative Video Address the Clinical Video Data Gap? Evaluation of Synthetic Parkinsonian Hand Motions
zh_title: 生成式视频能否填补临床视频数据缺口：合成帕金森手部动作评估
summary: 预印本：提出三维框架评估Sora 2生成的帕金森手部动作视频，发现视觉逼真但与真实临床视频显著偏离。
key_points: 提出视觉、生物力学与病理准确性三维评估框架
评估Sora 2生成MDS-UPDRS 0-2级手部动作
合成视频视觉逼真但与真实记录显著偏离
abstract: Computer vision approaches to disease motor assessment are limited by clinical video dataset scarcity and distributional imbalance, motivating interest in generative video models as a potential source of training data. We introduce a three-component framework for evaluating the clinical fidelity of synthetic medical motion data, assessing visual fidelity, biomechanical stability, and pathophysiological accuracy, and apply it to videos generated by the text-to-video model Sora 2 depicting Parkinsonian hand-fisting motions across MDS-UPDRS severity levels 0-2 (normal to mild-moderate motor impairment). We further use real-versus-real bootstrapping to compare synthetic-real differences against the natural variability of real clinical videos. Although generated videos appear visually realistic, quantitative analysis shows substantial divergence from real clinical recordings, including weaker severity-dependent patterns of bradykinesia and hypokinesia, less realistic tremor rhythms, and substantial temporal instability. These findings reveal a motion-domain gap between Sora-2-generated and real clinical motor behavior in this Parkinsonian hand-motion setting and demonstrate that visual realism alone is insufficient to establish the clinical utility of synthetic video data for training or evaluating medical computer vision systems.
reason: 有新意的预印本评估方法，证据有限
zh_abstract: 用于疾病运动评估的计算机视觉方法受限于临床视频数据集稀缺和分布不平衡，这促使人们关注生成式视频模型作为潜在训练数据来源。我们提出一个由三部分组成的框架，用于评估合成医学运动数据的临床保真度，评估视觉保真度、生物力学稳定性和病理生理准确性，并将其应用于由文本到视频模型 Sora 2 生成的视频，这些视频描绘了 MDS-UPDRS 严重程度 0-2 级（正常至轻中度运动障碍）的帕金森样手部握拳运动。我们进一步使用真实对真实的自举法，将合成-真实差异与真实临床视频的自然变异性进行比较。尽管生成的视频在视觉上看起来逼真，但定量分析显示其与真实临床记录存在显著差异，包括运动迟缓（bradykinesia）和运动减少（hypokinesia）的严重程度依赖模式较弱、震颤节律较不真实以及显著的时间不稳定性。这些发现揭示了在此帕金森样手部运动场景中，Sora-2生成的运动行为与真实临床运动行为之间存在运动域差距，并表明仅凭视觉逼真度不足以确立合成视频数据用于训练或评估医学计算机视觉系统的临床效用。

title: Introducing Infrastructure as Code for deployment and governance of medical AI: A case study
zh_title: 以基础设施即代码实现医疗AI部署与治理：案例研究
summary: 案例研究提出用基础设施即代码自动配置合规后端、私有模型端点与身份管理，在三级中心快速部署受治理的临床AI。
key_points: 以机器可读文件定义网络、权限与服务端点
经浏览器或API访问AI功能，合规分析数据

abstract: Clinical AI deployment rarely reaches the bedside because both workstation integration and governed backend provisioning are challenging. We introduce a workflow that allows rapid and governed access to AI functionalities through a browser interface or API, enabling privacy-compliant data analysis. The complex setup for compliant healthcare applications such as a secure backend, private AI model endpoint, and managed identity configuration is encoded by itself, a concept known as Infrastructure as Code (IaC). IaC is a concept in which networks, access rights, and service endpoints are written down as machine-readable files that can be reviewed once and executed identically in any institution. Here, we apply this concept to a clinical use case. The process of deploying a governed, private clinical AI solution using this approach in a tertiary care center took, on average, 310.3 +- 196.6 seconds (n=25, mean +- SD). To further demonstrate the clinical value of this approach, we developed and deployed an LLM-based inconsistency checker, which identifies textual inconsistency in medical documents. When evaluating the tool on a set of 1,347 physician-approved clinical documents, the tool flagged a clinically severe inconsistency in 105 clinical documents (7.8%, approximately 1 in 13). In a severity-stratified physician audit, 149 of 150 sampled findings were confirmed (population-weighted PPV 98.2%; CI 94.8 - 100.0). In summary, we present the application of IaC frameworks to a healthcare use case and demonstrate that clinically useful AI applications can be deployed to physician workstations in hospital-governed cloud environments within a few minutes.

zh_abstract: 临床 AI 部署很少能到达床旁，因为工作站集成和受治理的后端配置都具有挑战性。我们介绍一种工作流程，可通过浏览器界面或 API 快速且受治理地访问 AI 功能，从而实现符合隐私要求的数据分析。对于合规医疗应用（如安全后端、私有 AI 模型端点和托管身份配置）的复杂设置，其本身即被编码，这一概念称为基础设施即代码（IaC）。IaC 是一种将网络、访问权限和服务端点写成机器可读文件的概念，这些文件可被审阅一次，并在任何机构中以相同方式执行。在此，我们将这一概念应用于一个临床用例。在一家三级医疗中心使用该方法部署受治理的私有临床 AI 解决方案的过程平均耗时 310.3 ± 196.6 秒（n=25，均值 ± 标准差）。为进一步证明该方法的临床价值，我们开发并部署了一个基于 LLM 的不一致性检查器，用于识别医疗文档中的文本不一致。在一组 1,347 份经医生批准的临床文档上评估该工具时，该工具在 105 份临床文档（7.8%，约每 13 份中 1 份）中标记出临床严重的不一致。在一项按严重程度分层的医生审核中，150 个抽样发现中有 149 个得到确认（人群加权 PPV 98.2%；CI 94.8–100.0）。总之，我们呈现了 IaC 框架在一个医疗用例中的应用，并证明具有临床实用价值的 AI 应用可在数分钟内被部署到医院治理的云环境中的医生工作站。

abstract: [Applied ergonomics] As emergency response environments become more complex and uncertain, artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to support emergency commanders' decision-making, yet there remains limited understanding of how emergency commanders use AI in real emergency contexts. Sixty-four active fire commanders completed a simulated emergency reconnaissance task involving unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) selection with AI assistance under varying levels of time pressure (with vs. without) and AI rank (superior vs. subordinate). Results showed that time pressure increased behavioral trust in AI while reducing commanders' perceived self-capability and decision accuracy. The superior AI elicited greater behavioral trust and was associated with better overall performance, despite identical AI accuracy across conditions. The effects of time pressure and AI rank on behavioral trust were realized through comparative judgments between perceived AI capability and perceived self-capability. In addition, AI rank influenced behavioral trust through perceived responsibility. These findings clarify how time pressure and role-based cues jointly shape trust in AI during emergency response and offer insights for the design of AI decision support in high-risk, time-critical work settings.

abstract: [Talanta] Catechol (Cat) quantification typically requires benchtop instrumentation, restricting its application for on-site environmental analysis. To address this, we developed a portable image-based biosensing platform that integrates a genetically engineered whole-cell biocatalyst with a Multi-Feature Fusion Vision Transformer (MF-ViT). An Escherichia coli strain expressing 2,3-dihydroxybiphenyl-1,2-dioxygenase (BphC) was constructed to specifically convert Cat into a measurable yellow product. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations provided a structural rationale for the sensor's analytical selectivity, demonstrating that specific bidentate coordination requirements prevent structural analogs from triggering false-positive signals. For signal decoding under ambient lighting, the MF-ViT model combined global visual representations with predefined colorimetric statistical features derived from the solution and background regions. This approach outperformed conventional simple RGB and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) analysis, achieving a high predictive accuracy (R2 = 0.944). The integrated biosensor exhibited a linear range of 12.5 to 400 nM and a limit of detection of 1.66 nM. Spiked recovery tests in seawater and tap water demonstrated that the smartphone-derived predictions were statistically consistent with standard spectrophotometric measurements. This approach provides a practical, algorithm-assisted strategy for the rapid screening of phenolic pollutants.

Although electroencephalography (EEG) has emerged as a promising non-invasive tool for identifying objective neurophysiological biomarkers of ADHD because of its high temporal resolution and cost-effectiveness, many existing machine learning studies rely on single-domain EEG features, which may not adequately capture the complex functional organization of the brain. MethodsThis study proposes a subject-level EEG classification framework that integrates three complementary feature domains: spectral characteristics, weighted Phase Lag Index (wPLI)-based functional connectivity, and topological descriptors derived from persistent homology. EEG recordings from 121 subjects were preprocessed and segmented into overlapping windows for feature extraction. Window-level features were aggregated to generate subject-level representations. Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) was employed to select the 110 most informative features from an initial set of 1,043 descriptors. Five machine learning classifiers, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), were evaluated using stratified five-fold cross-validation. An ablation study was further conducted to assess the contribution of each feature domain. Model interpretability was investigated using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME), two widely adopted Explainable Artificial Intelligence techniques for interpreting machine learning models. title: A Comprehensive Review on RNA Subcellular Localization Prediction
zh_title: RNA亚细胞定位预测综述
summary: 预印本综述：梳理用AI与机器学习预测lncRNA、mRNA等RNA亚细胞定位的计算方法，以替代耗时湿实验。

abstract: The subcellular localization of RNAs, including long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), messenger RNAs (mRNAs), microRNAs (miRNAs) and other smaller RNAs, plays a critical role in determining their biological functions. For instance, lncRNAs are predominantly associated with chromatin and act as regulators of gene transcription and chromatin structure, while mRNAs are distributed across the nucleus and cytoplasm, facilitating the transport of genetic information for protein synthesis. Understanding RNA localization sheds light on processes like gene expression regulation with spatial and temporal precision. However, traditional wet lab methods for determining RNA localization, such as in situ hybridization, are often time-consuming, resource-demanding, and costly. To overcome these challenges, computational methods leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have emerged as powerful alternatives, enabling large-scale prediction of RNA subcellular localization. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the latest advancements in AI-based approaches for RNA subcellular localization prediction, covering various RNA types and focusing on sequence-based, image-based, and hybrid methodologies that combine both data types. We highlight the potential of these methods to accelerate RNA research, uncover molecular pathways, and guide targeted disease treatments. Furthermore, we critically discuss the challenges in AI/ML approaches for RNA subcellular localization, such as data scarcity and lack of benchmarks, and opportunities to address them. This review aims to serve as a valuable resource for researchers seeking to develop innovative solutions in the field of RNA subcellular localization and beyond.

abstract: BackgroundPassively collected smartphone and wearable data, combined with genomic information, may enable scalable early identification of youth who are at risk for substance use disorder. However, heterogeneous data collected in naturalistic settings limit researcher control over data quality, requiring substantial preprocessing. Data cleaning and feature engineering decisions can meaningfully influence analytic outcomes yet are often minimally described or omitted in published work. ObjectivesWe provide rationales and recommendations for common preprocessing challenges in passive sensing research, including establishing inclusion criteria when "outliers" may reflect true behavioral variability, analyzing differences across smartphone operating systems, handling observations collected outside protocol windows, and engineering features for machine learning applications. MethodsWe illustrate principled approaches to these challenges using smartphone and Fitbit data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive DevelopmentSM Study (ABCD). The sample was drawn from the available half of the year-4 follow-up (data release 5.1; N = 4,754; ages 13-14). ResultsExtreme outlying observations were concentrated among low-engagement participants with few observed days. Smartphone usage among Apple users appeared under-recorded relative to Android users when compared with self-report measures. Fitbit-derived behavior differed systematically between observations collected within versus outside protocol windows. We also identified potential errors in the studys default preprocessing pipeline. ConclusionWe recommend prioritizing person-level inclusion criteria that preserve meaningful behavioral variability, examining temporal distributions rather than assuming observations are exchangeable, and thoroughly investigating and reporting data quality issues. Although illustrated using the ABCD Study, these principles broadly apply to research using smartphones, wearables, and other digital data sources.

title: Proteomic Signatures Capture Environmental Exposures Across Diverse Populations

abstract: Environmental exposures shape disease risk, but the generalizability of circulating protein-based readouts of exposures across diverse populations remains unknown. Using plasma proteomic profiles of 5,416 proteins in 10,043 participants from the All of Us Research Program, we evaluated associations with and composite scores of 100+ exposures, spanning adiposity, air pollution, ambient temperature, and substance use. We find that proteomic exposure signatures are largely consistent across populations and socioeconomic strata, with <1% of proteins showing significant cross-population heterogeneity, which included BMI as an exception, with leptin being the most heterogeneous association. Population-specific leptin trajectories adiposity, together with residual leptin-type 2 diabetes associations after BMI adjustment, revealed sex-specific metabolic risk not captured by BMI alone. Aggregated protein scores were largely exposure-specific, but substance-use scores showed cross-prediction and SES scores were broadly associated. PM2.5 protein scores captured within-region exposure variation and outperformed geographic and socioeconomic correlates, but spatial confounders remain embedded within protein-environment associations. Scores trained in UK Biobank transferred to All of Us for biologically proximal exposures, supporting cross-biobank portability. These findings establish plasma proteomics as a scalable framework for exposure measurement across diverse populations, while underscoring that responsible applications require careful consideration of biological context, social patterning, and cohort structure.

title: Imputing relative abundances via Gaussian random fields

abstract: Longitudinal studies with human participants frequently face the challenge of missing samples, which lead to incomplete trajectories of participant biomarkers and a reduction in data size. Existing approaches focus on single-variable imputation or model features one at a time, while neural networks typically require a large number of parameters and substantial training data. To address these challenges, we present an explainable model for multiple imputation of compositional samples based on a Gaussian random field (GRF). The model is specifically designed for longitudinal data: it incorporates participant-specific information and accounts for both temporal dependence across repeated observations and within-sample correlations, while using a moderate number of parameters. By coupling the GRF with sparse activation functions, the framework outputs sum-constrained compositions and explicitly models zero inflation. Under the Aitchison and Jensen--Shannon distances, our framework achieves imputation accuracy comparable to that of an observation-carrying baseline, while overcoming its static nature by modeling temporal trajectories and multivariate correlations. The resulting multiple imputations allow us to reconstruct complete datasets for downstream analysis and uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate the practical utility of our framework on gut microbiome datasets, restoring incomplete time series and achieving a balanced accuracy of 0.72 in predicting food allergy in infants (sensitivity 0.8) and of 0.64 in forecasting postpartum depression.

zh_abstract: 涉及人类参与者的纵向研究经常面临样本缺失的挑战，这会导致参与者生物标志物轨迹不完整并减少数据量。现有方法侧重于单变量插补或一次建模一个特征，而神经网络通常需要大量参数和大量训练数据。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种基于高斯随机场（Gaussian random field, GRF）的可解释模型，用于成分数据样本的多重插补。该模型专为纵向数据设计：它纳入参与者特异性信息，并考虑重复观测间的时间依赖性和样本内相关性，同时使用中等数量的参数。通过将 GRF 与稀疏激活函数耦合，该框架输出受和约束的成分，并明确建模零膨胀。在 Aitchison 距离和 Jensen–Shannon 距离下，我们的框架达到了与携带观测的基线相当的插补准确度，同时通过建模时间轨迹和多变量相关性克服了其静态性质。由此产生的多重插补使我们能够重建完整数据集，用于下游分析和不确定性量化。我们在肠道微生物组数据集上展示了该框架的实际效用，恢复了不完整的时间序列，并在预测婴儿食物过敏方面达到 0.72 的平衡准确率（灵敏度 0.8），在预测产后抑郁方面达到 0.64。

abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) preprocessing determines signal quality and interpretation, particularly for transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with EEG (TMS-EEG), where recordings are affected by large and complex stimulation-related artifacts. Several preprocessing approaches have been developed, but substantial variability remains in how pipelines are implemented, documented, and evaluated across recordings, limiting reproducibility and comparability across studies. We developed NESTApp, a MATLAB-based graphical interface built on EEGLAB, to provide an accessible and reproducible framework for implementing and evaluating TMS-EEG preprocessing pipelines. Rather than prescribing a specific pipeline, NESTApp allows users to construct and consistently apply customisable workflows incorporating established EEGLAB and TMS-EEG processing tools, while automatically documenting processing decisions and parameters. Integrated quality-control procedures track data removal and flag recordings based on user-defined criteria, facilitating systematic evaluation across participants. The application also supports group-level visualisation and export of processed TMS-EEG measures for subsequent analyses. Applied to 29 recordings from 16 participants, NESTApp processed 27 and identified those requiring further inspection. By integrating pipeline implementation, documentation, quality control, and group-level evaluation within a single interface, NESTApp provides a transparent framework for TMS-EEG preprocessing that may improve reproducibility, facilitate consistent processing across cohorts, and lower technical barriers to the implementation of established preprocessing approaches.

title: Understanding clinician engagement with electronic health records: a mixed-methods study of structured data entry using the Theory of Planned Behaviour
zh_title: NHS医生电子病历结构化录入行为研究
summary: 在伦敦某NHS教学医院以计划行为理论与语料库语言学，混合方法分析医生电子病历结构化数据录入行为。

abstract: BackgroundElectronic health records (EHRs) are central to NHS clinical practice, and the value of the data they hold depends on clinicians entering structured data. Structured data entry (SDE) is nonetheless used inconsistently, and most evidence comes from US settings documenting barriers rather than the mechanisms interventions must target. This is, to our knowledge, the first study to apply the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB) to SDE, to examine SDE behaviour among UK NHS doctors, and to apply corpus linguistics to clinicians free-text accounts of EHR use. MethodsA two-part mixed-methods study was conducted at a large NHS teaching hospital in central London using the Epic EHR. Study 1 was a cross-sectional survey of non-consultant grade doctors comprising the System Usability Scale (SUS), a purpose-designed TPB questionnaire, and two open-text questions analysed using corpus linguistics. Study 2 was an Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (IPA) of semi-structured interviews with six resident doctors. ResultsEighty-three doctors responded; 65 completed the SUS and 49 the TPB questionnaire. Mean SUS score was 62.1 (95% CI 58.3-65.9), below the benchmark of 68 and equivalent to a grade of "D". Structured features were used markedly less often than narrative notes. TPB constructs explained 56% of the variance in intention (F(3,45) = 18.95, p < .001); attitudes (p = .003) and subjective norms (p = .009) predicted intention independently, whereas perceived behavioural control did not (p = .14). Intention predicted self-reported use of problem lists, event-specific templates and standardised documents, but not narrative notes. Corpus analysis identified time pressure and interface friction as dominant barriers. IPA generated four themes: structured documentation as cognitive relief; as fragile collective infrastructure; as a practice clinicians are expected to perform but not enabled to learn; and as a format that can flatten clinical reasoning. ConclusionsEngagement with SDE is driven principally by attitudes and social norms rather than by perceived control, and the barriers clinicians describe arise from the intersection of interface design, training, team norms and institutional expectation. Interventions addressing usability alone are unlikely to succeed: sustained change requires team-level normative reinforcement, specialty-relevant training that explains both how and why, and systems that preserve space for clinical narrative.

zh_abstract: 【背景】电子健康记录（EHR）是NHS临床实践的核心，其所含数据的价值取决于临床医生录入结构化数据。尽管如此，结构化数据录入（SDE）的使用仍不一致，且大多数证据来自美国环境，记录的是障碍而非干预必须针对的机制。据我们所知，这是首个将计划行为理论（TPB）应用于SDE、考察英国NHS医生SDE行为，并将语料库语言学应用于临床医生关于EHR使用的自由文本叙述的研究。【方法】在伦敦市中心一家使用Epic EHR的大型NHS教学医院开展了一项由两部分组成的混合方法研究。研究1是对非顾问级别医生进行的横断面调查，包括系统可用性量表（SUS）、专门设计的TPB问卷，以及两个使用语料库语言学分析的开放文本问题。研究2是对六名住院医生半结构化访谈进行的解释现象学分析（IPA）。【结果】83名医生作出回应；65名完成了SUS，49名完成了TPB问卷。平均SUS得分为62.1（95% CI 58.3–65.9），低于68的基准，相当于“D”级。结构化功能的使用频率明显低于叙述性记录。TPB构念解释了意向方差的56%（F(3,45) = 18.95，p < .001）；态度（p = .003）和主观规范（p = .009）独立预测意向，而感知行为控制则没有（p = .14）。意向预测了自我报告的问题列表、事件特定模板和标准化文档的使用，但不能预测叙述性记录的使用。语料库分析确定时间压力和界面摩擦是主要障碍。IPA产生了四个主题：结构化记录作为认知缓解；作为脆弱的集体基础设施；作为一种临床医生被期望执行但未被赋能学习的实践；以及作为一种可能压平临床推理的格式。【结论】对SDE的参与主要由态度和社会规范而非感知控制驱动，临床医生描述的障碍源于界面设计、培训、团队规范和机构期望的交叉。仅解决可用性的干预不太可能成功：持续改变需要团队层面的规范强化、解释如何做以及为何做的专科相关培训，以及为临床叙事保留空间的系统。

abstract: Background and ObjectiveLung function reference equations are essential for interpreting spirometry and related modalities, yet existing tools are fragmented, modality- and language-specific (predominantly R), and lack integrated severity classifiers. We present PySpiro, an open-source Python library unifying 23 spirometry, 1 multiple breath washout, 2 diffusing capacity, 1 static lung volume, and 2 oscillometry reference equations under a single API, with 10 clinical severity classifiers. MethodsPySpiro was implemented in Python 3 using NumPy and pandas, with all equations coded directly from literature. The unified API exposes predicted medians, z-scores, limits of normal (LLN/ULN), and raw Lambda-Mu-Sigma (LMS) triplets per parameter, plus a vectorised compute() method for batch processing at the DataFrame level. Unit-tests covering every equation and classifier verify agreement with published values and confirm correct boundary, out-of-range, and missing-input handling. ResultsPySpiro covers spirometry equations from 1971 to 2022 across Caucasian, Asian, Indian, and race-neutral global populations, plus non-spirometry modalities (multiple breath washout, diffusing capacity, static lung volumes, oscillometry). Classifiers span COPD, interstitial lung disease, pattern and severity grading, bronchodilator reversibility, and primary ciliary dyskinesia. Compared with rspiro (5 equations, 4 spirometry) and the only prior Python package (spiref, 2 equations, no z-scores or % predicted), PySpiro offers substantially broader coverage, multi-modality support, a richer output API, and 10 classifiers absent from both. ConclusionsPySpiro is freely available (PyPI: pyspiro; doi:10.5281/zenodo.15519193) and provides a comprehensive, validated, and extensible platform for lung function data analysis in research pipelines.

zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】肺功能参考方程对于解释肺量计及相关模式至关重要，但现有工具分散、依模式与语言而异（主要是 R 语言），且缺乏整合的严重程度分类器。我们提出 PySpiro，一个开源 Python 库，在单一 API 下统一 23 个肺量计参考方程、1 个多次呼吸洗出参考方程、2 个弥散能力参考方程、1 个静态肺容积参考方程和 2 个振荡肺功能参考方程，并包含 10 个临床严重程度分类器。【方法】PySpiro 使用 Python 3 实现，基于 NumPy 和 pandas，所有方程均直接依据文献编码。统一 API 可输出每个参数的预测中位数、z 分数、正常值限（LLN/ULN）和原始 Lambda-Mu-Sigma（LMS）三元组，并提供一个向量化 compute() 方法，用于在 DataFrame 层面进行批处理。覆盖每个方程和分类器的单元测试验证了与已发表值的一致性，并确认了边界、超出范围和缺失输入处理的正确性。【结果】PySpiro 覆盖 1971 年至 2022 年的肺量计方程，涵盖高加索人、亚洲人、印度人和种族中性全球人群，并包括非肺量计模式（多次呼吸洗出、弥散能力、静态肺容积、振荡肺功能）。分类器涵盖 COPD、间质性肺病、模式和严重程度分级、支气管扩张剂可逆性以及原发性纤毛运动障碍。与 rspiro（5 个方程，4 个肺量计方程）以及此前唯一的 Python 包（spiref，2 个方程，无 z 分数或预测百分比）相比，PySpiro 提供显著更广的覆盖、多模式支持、更丰富的输出 API，以及两者均缺失的 10 个分类器。【结论】PySpiro 可免费获取（PyPI：pyspiro；doi:10.5281/zenodo.15519193），为研究流程中的肺功能数据分析提供了一个全面、经过验证且可扩展的平台。
